entities.summary: Anwar Ahmed "Anu" Khan was a Pakistani field hockey player who won an Olympic gold medal at the 1960 Summer Olympics and two silver medals at the 1956 and 1964 Olympics, as well as gold medals at the Asian Games in 1958 and 1962. An exceptional center half, he is known as the Rock of Gibraltar.
